query: How to report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities?
reference_answer:
Reporting Traffic Signal Malfunctions:
To report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities, call the police control room (100) or contact the local traffic police station. You can also use the Tamil Nadu Police Department's mobile app or website to report the issue.
answer: To report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities, contact the local Traffic Police or the Municipal Corporation office. They have designated helplines or websites for such issues. [Document 1]
